content.short: Mint boatbuilder tradesmen to build your boat as well as accrue $YACHT passively.
content.description:
We will be bringing a chibi art collection to Cardano. 2000 NFTs complete a range of 5 different boatbuilder tradesmen from carpenter to engineer. You can use your boatbuilders to build a unique yacht NFT, based off of the combined rarity score of the builders along with a quantity of our native $YACHT token which can be pulled from our faucet or acquired through our discord server casino.

We will implement a staking system so you can passively earn $YACHT with your NFTs, either by smart contract integration or via regular, manual acquisition. Your yacht NFTs will also be stakable and will yield multiplied quantities of $YACHT.
